reason: The learned RL-Halting policy is trained by sampling loop depth and supervising the selected depth. Experiments are synthetic algorithmic length-generalization tasks; the main benefit is lower OOD variance and stability across inference-time loop counts, not demonstrated reductions to LLM serving cost or latency. Authors explicitly frame stopping as a training-time design choice and note learned schedules can stabilize a suboptimal computation.
title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping
